invariants.name: No Source Manufacture
invariants.rule: Missing provenance remains missing.

invariants.name: No Historical Reopen
invariants.rule: Closed execution instances are immutable. New evidence creates a new Reference/Audit Sequence.

invariants.name: Local Barrier
invariants.rule: Only dependent edges are blocked by unresolved required returns.

invariants.name: Progression Not Closure
invariants.rule: An unaccepted required return blocks successful progression but may permit terminal FAILURE/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/ABORTED closure if the contract defines it.

invariants.name: No In-Place Sequence Restart
invariants.rule: A new attempt is a new Sequence instance.

invariants.name: Open-Parent Re-evaluation Allowed
invariants.rule: Re-evaluating an open node after an attached return is not reopening the Sequence.

invariants.name: Entity Outcome Not Sequence Closure
invariants.rule: Entity lifecycle/outcome and Sequence terminal status are orthogonal records.

invariants.name: Role Separation
invariants.rule: Driver, Controller, Carrier, Performer and Transition Mechanism are separate machine fields.

invariants.name: Requirement Conditional
invariants.rule: Requirement is conditional; Acceptance/Analysis Contract is universal.

invariants.name: Edge Evaluation Separation
invariants.rule: Trigger, Threshold, Evaluator, Evaluation Policy and Recheck Policy are distinct.

invariants.name: Order Not Causality
invariants.rule: Declared order does not imply causal relation.

invariants.name: Encounter Conditional
invariants.rule: Encounter/Access may be absent when the relation/coupling already exists.

invariants.name: Seed Not Intent Not Open Sequence
invariants.rule: A Seed may be latent, carrier-less and closed-result-derived without itself being an open Sequence or intentional.

invariants.name: Global Reality Not Actor View
invariants.rule: Actor/observer knowledge state never silently becomes global truth.

invariants.name: Trace Not Memory
invariants.rule: Trace is persistent path evidence; Memory is encoded/addressable for later retrieval or reuse.

invariants.name: Close Condition Not Acceptance Condition
invariants.rule: Execution can close while its returned result is not accepted by a requester.

invariants.name: Template Not Instance
invariants.rule: Template/schema versioning never rewrites immutable historical execution instances.

invariants.name: Typed Nulls
invariants.rule: UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, CONTRADICTORY, NOT_APPLICABLE, ABSENT, UNDECLARED, REDACTED and ERROR remain distinct.

invariants.name: Contradiction Preserved
invariants.rule: Supported contradiction is stored, never averaged away.

invariants.name: Pass-3 Before Immutable Closure
invariants.rule: Pass-3 integrity audit occurs before immutable closure; later audits are new Sequences.

invariants.name: Cross-Sequence Relations First-Class
invariants.rule: Main, Local/Rider, Attached, Next, Reference, Counter, Observer/Audit, Parallel and Convergent relations are not collapsed into one parent-child relation.

invariants.name: Optional Modules Not Forced
invariants.rule: Universality means representability without false semantics; conditional modules may close NOT_APPLICABLE or be omitted according to schema.

invariants.name: Registered Edge Firing Contract
invariants.rule: Every executable edge has a registered firing contract rather than prose-only control flow.

invariants.name: Claim Epistemic/Provenance Required
invariants.rule: Every machine-relevant claim has provenance/epistemic state or an explicit gap.

invariants.name: Versioned Structural Change
invariants.rule: Every canonical structural change is versioned and migration-aware.
